description: Figure 5 is a line plot illustrating nDCG@10 performance for several DPR variants as the number of queries used during inference (S) increases. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S)” on a linear scale, spanning from 1 to 10 with integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled “nDCG@10” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 33.0 to 36.0 with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. Four lines are shown: a red solid line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/o query,” which rises from about 35.0 at S=1 to about 35.8 by S=10 with small incremental increases; a black solid line with square markers labeled “DPR w/ corpus expansion,” which stays near 34.8–35.0 across S=1–10, starting around 34.8 at S=1 and ending around 34.9 at S=10 with minor fluctuations; a green solid line with upward-triangle markers labeled “DPR w/ document expansion,” which starts around 34.7 at S=1, reaches about 35.0 around S=5, and then trends slightly downward to about 34.8 by S=10; and a blue solid line with downward-triangle markers labeled “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion,” which begins around 34.7 at S=1, peaks near 35.0 around S=2, and then gradually declines to about 34.4 by S=10.
